values.title: Card issuer automatically opened a preliminary investigation into a duplicate drainage-fittings transaction
values.body: The antifraud system automatically opened disp_qgrd_01 and is checking only tx_qgrd_dup; this is not a dispute submitted by Evan Young or an agent, and it does not constitute payment, a refund, or external authorization. Regular bills must still be handled by the due date, and an update is expected on July 8.
